name: Block Chain Address Wallet 5
definition: Digital account where digital assets or digital tokens can be stored and where an entry is made.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification of the collateral account.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Indicates the type of collateral account.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the account. It provides an additional means of identification, and is designated by the account servicer in agreement with the account owner.
